description: A React component for rendering a customizable data table with features like filtering, sorting, pagination, cross-filtering, and time comparison, integrated with Apache Superset.

classes.name: TableChart
classes.description: React functional component for displaying a data table with advanced features such as filtering, sorting, pagination, and cross-filtering within Apache Superset.

methods.name: getGridHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of the data grid based on total height and whether search is included.

methods.name: handleColumnStateChange
methods.description: Callback to handle changes in column state, propagates to parent if provided.

methods.name: handleFilterChanged
methods.description: Handles filter changes, updates chart state and server pagination state accordingly.

methods.name: isActiveFilterValue
methods.description: Checks if a given filter value is active for a specific key.

methods.name: timestampFormatter
methods.description: Formats timestamp values based on whether raw records are used and the specified time grain.

methods.name: toggleFilter
methods.description: Handles cell click events to apply cross-filters if enabled.

methods.name: handleServerPaginationChange
methods.description: Updates pagination state when page number changes.

methods.name: handlePageSizeChange
methods.description: Updates pagination state when page size changes.

methods.name: handleChangeSearchCol
methods.description: Updates search column in state when user changes search column.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Handles search input, updates state and resets to first page.

methods.name: handleSortByChange
methods.description: Updates sorting state based on user selection.

methods.name: renderTimeComparisonVisibility
methods.description: Renders the time comparison dropdown component.
